title: Advanced Analysis for Modern Heavy Music
description: Non-functional harmony, unusual meter, riff-as-harmony, and an analysis method that does not force a chorale onto a blast-beat song.

sourceReferences.title: MIT 21M.350 Musical Analysis
sourceReferences.notes: Form and analysis as a method. We reuse the method on riff-based music rather than copying the repertoire.

sourceReferences.title: MIT 21M.302
sourceReferences.notes: Chromatic craft is the last common-practice tool this course still needs.

modules.title: Beyond function
modules.blurb: Planing, mediants, modes that refuse a dominant.

concepts.name: Non-functional harmony
concepts.summary: Progression that does not report to a dominant.

concepts.name: Planing
concepts.summary: A shape that slides, keeping its intervals.

concepts.name: Chromatic mediants
concepts.summary: Roots a third apart, few common tones, a lot of color.

concepts.name: Tritone relationships
concepts.summary: The interval that bisects the octave.

concepts.name: Locrian and the diminished tonic
concepts.summary: A mode whose tonic triad is already unstable.

concepts.name: Phrygian and the flat second
concepts.summary: The half-step above the tonic as a signature.

concepts.name: Harmonic minor as a metal default
concepts.summary: The raised seventh without the rest of the classical contract.

concepts.name: Octatonic collections
concepts.summary: Alternating tones and semitones, two flavors.

concepts.name: Odd meter
concepts.summary: Bars that are not 2 or 4 on the surface.

concepts.name: Polymeter
concepts.summary: Two meters at once, coinciding later.

concepts.name: Metric ambiguity
concepts.summary: A pulse you cannot yet group.

concepts.name: Rhythmic displacement
concepts.summary: The same cell, started on a different beat.

concepts.name: Hemiola and 3:2
concepts.summary: Three in the time of two, or the reverse.

concepts.name: Riff-based harmony
concepts.summary: The riff is the progression.

concepts.name: Pedal-tone riffs
concepts.summary: An open string that everything else grinds against.

concepts.name: Chromatic riff cells
concepts.summary: Semitone motion as the material, not the decoration.

concepts.name: Cluster and close dissonance
concepts.summary: Seconds stacked until the chord has no name.

concepts.name: Form built from riffs
concepts.summary: Contrast and return without a verse-chorus contract.

concepts.name: What analysis is for
concepts.summary: A method: what repeats, what contrasts, what is the cell.

concepts.name: Reduction without forcing a chorale
concepts.summary: Strip the surface. Do not invent a I–V that is not there.

concepts.name: Distortion as a harmonic fact
concepts.summary: Gain adds partials. A fifth becomes a crowd.

concepts.name: Drop tunings and string physics
concepts.summary: A lowered sixth string that makes the power chord one finger.
